## 1. Load libraries

```{r}
#| label: load-libraries

library(data.table)
library(susieR)
```

## 2. Load data

```{r}
#| label: load-data

expr_dt <- fread("data/student_trial_expression.txt")
pheno_dt <- fread("data/phenotypes-20260429.txt")
geno_dt <- fread("data/student_trial_genotypes.txt")
gemma_gwas_dt <- fread("data/student_trial_gemma.txt")
eqtl_dt <- fread("data/student_trial_eqtl.txt")

stopifnot(
  identical(
    names(expr_dt)[-1],
    names(geno_dt)[-1]
  )
)
```
